name: Stack Exchange API
rate_limits: Without API key: 300 requests/day. With free API key: 10,000 requests/day. Responses are gzip-compressed. Must include User-Agent header to avoid throttling.
notes: Covers all Stack Exchange sites including Stack Overflow (the largest Q&A site for programmers). API v2.3 is current. No auth needed for read-only access but an API key (free registration) raises daily limit from 300 to 10,000. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination. Site parameter selects which SE network site to query (stackoverflow, serverfault, askubuntu, etc.). OAuth 2.0 for write access. JSONP supported via callback parameter. Excellent for technical Q&A data, code examples, error resolution, and developer knowledge mining.
